789-1829-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-1829-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-1070-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-5147.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

141-1854-3899.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-3899.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-2438-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

978-4247--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

510-2281-8095.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

586-728-864-3125-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-728-864-3125-7396.description:
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

880-4871-7893.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4871-7893.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

81-2021-2060-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

4377-6568-7757-7758.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
4377-6568-7757-7758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Y'shtola Rhul.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Walk the Aeons.
Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

141-3125-6798.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Naru Meha and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3330-3490-4050-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

719-6705-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Xenograft, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
Repeat step 3.
719-6705-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

178-3259-4460.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Animate Basalt Monolith using Donatello.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-6249-7256--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Evendo, Waking Haven.

Repeat.

Activate Megatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

When the Thopter and Treasure enter the battlefield, Haliya triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

826-3464-3899-6243.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.

Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Ornithopter and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.

At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness.
When the token Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2457-2557-3129-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

997-2082-3197.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
997-2082-3197.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
997-2082-3197.description:

Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.

Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Archelos is untapped.

Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Esoteric Duplicator triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus at the beginning of your next end step.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Esoteric Duplicator triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Repeat.

1692-2808.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Enduring Scalelord.
Helm of the Host attached to Enduring Scalelord.

Repeat step 3.

When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.

Repeat.

876-1171-2034-5003.description:

Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding three mana of any one color.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Garth One-Eye, adding {C}{C}.
Garth One-Eye dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Garth One-Eye from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

1202-3249-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, adding {R}.
Myr Moonvessel triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Myr Moonvessel.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat.

352-2713-4821.description:

Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage by paying {U}{R}, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{R}.
